claims.claim: Celestica Q2 2026 revenue reached $4.70B, up 62% year over year, and exceeded the high end of guidance; management raised the annual outlook and expects growth to accelerate in 2027.

factors.name: AI hardware manufacturing exposure
factors.basis: Strong growth and raised outlook align with strengthening data-center infrastructure demand.

risks.risk: Large customer programs and rapid capacity growth can create concentration and execution risk.

causalEdges.mechanism: higher data-center capex drives hardware-platform and manufacturing volumes
causalEdges.falsifier: customer capex slows or insourcing reduces Celestica content

unknowns.unknown: Customer-specific concentration and program economics are not established here.

claims.claim: Q2 adjusted operating margin reached 8.2% versus 7.4% a year earlier and adjusted EPS reached $2.54 versus $1.39, showing earnings growth faster than revenue.

factors.name: Operating leverage
factors.basis: Margin and EPS expansion accompanied rapid revenue growth.

risks.risk: Raised expectations increase downside sensitivity to program delays or margin normalization.

causalEdges.mechanism: scale can improve absorption and margins
causalEdges.falsifier: cost inflation or mix deterioration reverses margin gains

unknowns.unknown: No canonical live valuation input is asserted.
